arxiv-2103-04734.title: Searchlight Asymptotics for High-Frequency Scattering by Boundary Inflection
arxiv-2103-04734.creator: V.P. Smyshlyaev, I.V. Kamotski
arxiv-2103-04734.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by V.P. Smyshlyaev, I.V. Kamotski. We consider an inner problem for whispering gallery high-frequency asymptotic mode’s scattering by a boundary inflection. The related boundary-value problem for a Schrödinger equation on a half-line with a potential linear in both space and time appears fundamental for describing transitions from modal to scattered asymptotic patterns, and despite having been intensively studied over several decades remains largely unsolved.

arxiv-2104-14758.creator: A. P. Beardsley 1, B. Crosse 2, D. Emrich 3, T. M. O. Franzen 2, B. M. Gaensler 4 , 11 , 5, L. Horsley 3, M. Johnston-Hollitt 2, D. L. Kaplan 7, D. Kenney 2, M. F. arxiv-2104-14758.description: Abstract Here we present stringent low-frequency (185 MHz) limits on coherent radio emission associated with a short-duration gamma-ray burst (SGRB). Our observations of the short gamma-ray burst (GRB) 180805A were taken with the upgraded Murchison Widefield Array (MWA) rapid-response system, which triggered within 20 s of receiving the transient alert from the Swift Burst Alert Telescope, corresponding to 83.

arxiv-2109-09313.title: Magnetic moment of the Ξ b ​ ( 6227 ) \Xi_{b}(6227) as a molecular pentaquark state
arxiv-2109-09313.creator: Ulaş Özdem
arxiv-2109-09313.description: Abstract In this study, considering that the Ξ b ​ ( 6227 ) \Xi_{b}(6227) state is in molecular structure, the magnetic moment of this state is extracted in the light-cone QCD sum rules. The numerical result is obtained as μ Ξ b = 0.12 ± 0.03 ​ μ N \mu_{\Xi_{b}}=0.12\pm 0.03~\mu_{N} .

arxiv-2405-09491.title: The McKay correspondence for dihedral groups: The Moduli Space and the Tautological Bundles
arxiv-2405-09491.creator: John Ashley Capellan
arxiv-2405-09491.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by John Ashley Capellan. A conjecture posed by Ishii states that for a finite subgroup G G of GL ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) \operatorname{GL}(2,\mathbb{C}) , a resolution Y Y of ℂ 2 / G \mathbb{C}^{2}/G is isomorphic to a moduli space ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} of G G -constellations for some generic stability parameter θ \theta if and only if Y Y is dominated by the maximal resolution.

arxiv-2501-02370.title: Prepending or Cross-Attention for Speech-to-Text? An Empirical Comparison
arxiv-2501-02370.creator: Tsz Kin Lam, Marco Gaido, Sara Papi, Luisa Bentivogli, Barry Haddow
arxiv-2501-02370.description: Abstract Following the remarkable success of Large Language Models (LLMs) in NLP tasks, there is increasing interest in extending their capabilities to speech—the most common form of communication. The most widespread approach to integrating speech into LLMs is dense feature prepending (DFP), which prepends the projected speech representations to the textual representations, allowing end-to-end training with a speech encoder.

arxiv-2502-01174.title: On Geometrization of Classical Fields (Model of Embedded Spaces)
arxiv-2502-01174.creator: V. I. Noskov
arxiv-2502-01174.description: Abstract Abstract – The possibility of geometrization of the gravitational and electro magnetic fields in 4D Finsler space (the Model of Embedded Spaces – MES) is investigated. The model postulates a proper metric set of an element of distributed matter and asserts that space-time is a mutual physical embedding of such sets.

arxiv-2502-17223.title: On the admissibility of bounds on the mean of discrete, scalar probability distributions from an iid sample
arxiv-2502-17223.creator: Erik Learned-Miller
arxiv-2502-17223.description: Abstract We address the problem of producing a lower bound for the mean of a discrete probability distribution, with known support over a finite set of real numbers, from an iid sample of that distribution. Up to a constant, this is equivalent to bounding the mean of a multinomial distribution (with known support) from a sample of that distribution.

arxiv-2506-06261.title: Reflect-then-Plan: Offline Model-Based Planning through a Doubly Bayesian Lens
arxiv-2506-06261.creator: Jihwan Jeong, Xiaoyu Wang, Jingmin Wang, Scott Sanner, Pascal Poupart
arxiv-2506-06261.description: Abstract Offline reinforcement learning (RL) is crucial when online exploration is costly or unsafe but often struggles with high epistemic uncertainty due to limited data. Most of existing methods rely on fixed conservative policies, restricting adaptivity and generalization. To address this, we propose Reflect-then-Plan (RefPlan), a novel doubly Bayesian offline model-based (MB) planning approach.

arxiv-2507-17240.title: Perceptual Classifiers: Detecting Generative Images using Perceptual Features
arxiv-2507-17240.creator: Krishna Srikar Durbha Perceptual Classifiers: Detecting Generative Images using Perceptual Features, Asvin Kumar Venkataramanan Perceptual Classifiers: Detecting Generative Images using Perceptual Features, Rajesh Sureddi, Alan C. Bovik
arxiv-2507-17240.description: Abstract Image Quality Assessment (IQA) models are employed in many practical image and video processing pipelines to reduce storage, minimize transmission costs, and improve the Quality of Experience (QoE) of millions of viewers. These models are sensitive to a diverse range of image distortions and can accurately predict image quality as judged by human viewers.

arxiv-2509-17534.title: On the spectral stability of the periodic capillary-gravity waves
arxiv-2509-17534.creator: Changzhen Sun, Erik Wahlén
arxiv-2509-17534.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate the spectral stability of periodic traveling waves in the two dimensional gravity-capillary water wave problem. We derive a stability criterion based on an index function, whose sign determines the spectral stability of the waves.

arxiv-2601-06034.title: Autonomous QA Agent: A Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Reliable Selenium Script Generation
arxiv-2601-06034.creator: Dudekula Kasim Vali
arxiv-2601-06034.description: Abstract Software testing is critical in the software development lifecycle, yet translating requirements into executable test scripts remains manual and error-prone. While Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate code, they often hallucinate non-existent UI elements. We present the Autonomous QA Agent , a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that grounds Selenium script generation in project-specific documentation and HTML structure.

pmc-11560268.title: Molecular detection of Cryptosporidium spp. among wild rats in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia
pmc-11560268.creator: Endang Suprihati, Heni Puspitasari, Elly Nur Indasari, Ponasari Galuh, Lucia Tri suwanti, Mufasirin Mufasirin, Poedji Hastutiek, Boedi Setiawan
pmc-11560268.description: Background:Humans and animals who have an acute case of diarrhea can be infected with Cryptosporidium spp. Within the category of water-borne disease, it is a zoonotic disease. The zoonotic disease Cryptosporidium is among the several pathogens carried by wild rats (Rattus spp.).

pmc-11680124.title: scTRIM44 Positively Regulated Siniperca Chuatsi Rhabdovirus Through RIG-I- and MDA5-Mediated Interferon Signaling
pmc-11680124.creator: Yinjie Niu, Xinmei Yang, Hongru Liang, Xia Luo, Baofu Ma, Qiang Lin, Xiaozhe Fu, Ningqiu Li
pmc-11680124.description: Tripartite Motif-Containing 44 (TRIM44) is responsible for cancers, neurodegenerative diseases, and viral infections. However, the role of Siniperca chuatsi TRIM44 (scTRIM44) during viral infection remains unclear. In the present study, we analyzed the molecular characteristics of scTRIM44 and its role in infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV), largemouth bass virus (LMBV), and Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV) infection.

pmc-12421674.title: Sequence-Dependent Shape and Stiffness of DNA and RNA Double Helices: Hexanucleotide Scale and Beyond
pmc-12421674.creator: Pavlína Slavníková, Marek Cuker, Eva Matoušková, Ivan Čmelo, Marie Zgarbová, Petr Jurečka, Filip Lankaš
pmc-12421674.description: The structure and deformability of double-stranded DNA and RNA depend on the sequence of bases, affecting biological processes and nanostructure design, but this dependence is incompletely understood. Here we present mechanical properties of DNA and RNA duplexes inferred from atomic-resolution, explicit-solvent molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of 107 DNA and 107 RNA oligomers containing all hexanucleotide sequences.

pmc-13209037.title: Clinical Trajectories of Neurodegenerative Diseases in Older Adults: A Three-Sphere Framework for Precision Geriatric Neurology
pmc-13209037.creator: Crescenzo Testa, Francesco Palmese, Stefano Boni, Marco Domenicali, Fulvio Lauretani
pmc-13209037.description: Neurodegenerative diseases are among the most consequential disorders of later life, not only because of their increasing prevalence, rising from approximately 1–2% at age 65 to over 30% by age 85, but also because they develop within the broader clinical context of ageing, multimorbidity, frailty, and polypharmacy.

pmc-13296701.title: Activation of sarco/endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+-ATPase 2 (SERCA2) reduces brain injury and improves cognitive function following ischemic stroke
pmc-13296701.creator: Mohd Salman, Abdul Majid, Syamal K Bhattacharya, Djamel Lebeche, Tauheed Ishrat
pmc-13296701.description: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of death and long-term disability worldwide, driven in part by disrupted intracellular calcium (Ca2+) homeostasis, endoplasmic reticulum stress, oxidative damage, and neuroinflammation. The sarco/endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+-ATPase 2 (SERCA2) pump is essential for maintaining intracellular Ca2+ balance, and its dysfunction contributes to ischemic neuronal injury.

pmc-13507337.title: Association between baseline pulse pressure and prognosis in critically ill patients: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13507337.creator: Yifan Gao, Wei Su, Yinshan Wu, Ying Chen, Senbin Hu, Zhendong Fang, Weipeng Huang, Jiali Mao, Kedi Gao, Minmin Chen, Qixun Luo, Shu Cao, Feng Guo

pmc-13615674.title: Tailless terminates the neural stem cell temporal cascade in both the optic lobe and central brain
pmc-13615674.creator: Jocelyn L Y Tang, Alex P A Donovan, Andrea H Brand
pmc-13615674.description: Temporal patterning is an evolutionarily conserved mechanism to produce neuronal and glial diversity from common cells of origin during neurodevelopment. This process is controlled by a series of temporal transcription factors that are transiently expressed and drive the sequential production of specific progeny subtypes.

Parainfluenza virus serological reagents are devices that consist of antigens and antisera used in serological tests to identify antibodies to parainfluenza virus in serum.
